new_jobs.description:
R10098748 Senior eCommerce Operations Analyst (Open)

Location:

Radnor, PA (Airgas HO) - Management

How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?

Airgas is elevating the online customer journey by transitioning to a modern, integrated eCommerce ecosystem. We are seeking a Senior eCommerce Operations Analyst to serve as the team’s technical optimizer and efficiency orchestrator.

In this role, you are a guardian of system health—ensuring data flows seamlessly between our PIM, DAM, and Commerce platforms. We are looking for a disciplined, self-starting professional who uses an 'efficiency mindset' to transform manual routines into automated, reliable processes. The ideal candidate is an expert at leveraging AI tools to solve technical challenges, document complex workflows, and iterate on internal utilities based on user feedback. You are someone who evaluates business problems through a pragmatic lens, providing technical support for supplier integrations and recommending the most effective paths forward to ensure operational excellence . High personal accountability and professional consistency are essential to ensure the team remains synchronized and responsive.

Key Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned to meet the evolving needs of the business.

System Health & Orchestration

Automated Monitoring: Design and implement automated health-check protocols across the core tech stack (Salesforce, Coveo, Viamedici, etc.). Use AI tools to monitor the "handshakes" between platforms, ensuring product data and assets flow seamlessly through our headless architecture.

Consistency Oversight: Shift the team from manual reporting to exception-based monitoring; ensure that system checks are consistent, documented, and yield actionable data.

Efficiency & Problem Synthesis

Option Evaluation: Identify operational friction points and evaluate potential solutions. Present "Option Evaluations" to leadership, comparing the ROI of a process change, a third-party tool "buy," or an AI-assisted internal "build."

User-Led Iteration: Continuously evolve and enhance internal utilities and automation scripts based on direct feedback from the Merchandising team, ensuring tools remain pragmatic, user-friendly, and functionally relevant.

Root Cause Analysis: Analyze ticket patterns to identify systemic "handshake" errors or platform gaps. Translate these findings into clear technical requirements for the Digital Product Management (DPM) team.

AI-Driven Operational Hygiene

SOP Ownership: Own the technical accuracy and organizational standard of the team’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) library.

AI Leverage: Act as the team’s lead "Prompt Engineer," utilizing Generative AI (Google Gemini, NotebookLM) to accelerate the creation of documentation, debug platform logs, and generate efficiency-driving scripts (Python/Apps Script).

Merchandising Enablement & Guidance

Integration Support: Serve as the technical support resource during strategic discussions regarding the "wiring up" of supplier PIM systems to our internal PIM via API connections.

Technical Support: Partner with Merchandising Specialists to remove technical bottlenecks, helping them accelerate "speed to shelf" through optimized data ingestion and tool usage.

Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and "second-level" troubleshooting support to the eCommerce Operations Analyst, ensuring a shared high standard of operational excellence across the team.

JOB INTERACTION NETWORK

INTERNAL

Digital Merchandising Team

Promotions & Personalization Team

User Experience Team

Web Operations (Digital Product Management, Digital Quality Assurance)

Creative

Digital Marketing

EXTERNAL

Viamedici

Coveo

Salesforce

Accenture

EPAM

Product Manufacturers

Other 3rd Party Vendors

________________________Are you a MATCH?

Required Education & Qualifications

Required Education:

Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business-related discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or Communications); or equivalent professional experience in eCommerce operations and data management demonstrating advanced technical logic and problem-solving skills.

Required Length & Type of Experience:

3–5 years of experience in an eCommerce operations or technical analyst role, specifically within an integrated enterprise environment.

Operational Consistency: A proven track record of managing daily platform health checks and recurring operational routines with high reliability.

Technical Option Evaluation: Experience identifying business friction points and presenting technical options (Pros/Cons/ROI) to leadership to support decision-making.

System Synchronization: Direct experience monitoring data flows between enterprise platforms (e.g., PIM, DAM, and Commerce engines) in a headless or integrated architecture.

Pragmatic Automation: Experience building and maintaining "utility-scale" automation scripts or tools (e.g., Python, Google Apps Script) that solve specific manual inefficiencies.

Hybrid Accountability: Demonstrated success working independently in a hybrid environment, maintaining consistent professional core hours without constant supervision.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

AI-Augmented Operations: Skilled in using Generative AI and prompt engineering (e.g., Google Gemini, NotebookLM) to accelerate documentation, troubleshoot logs, and generate automation scripts.

Analytical Troubleshooting: Ability to analyze patterns in support tickets to identify root causes of systemic "handshake" errors between platforms.

Logic-Based Development: Functional proficiency in Python, SQL, or JavaScript; focuses on using code as a tool for efficiency rather than building overengineered solutions.

Platform Orchestration: Familiarity with how data moves through enterprise ecosystems like Salesforce Commerce, Coveo, and Viamedici.

Operational Hygiene: A strong commitment to technical documentation and the maintenance of a transparent SOP library.

Professional Discipline: The ability to remain "heads-down" and productive in a collaborative cube environment, prioritizing critical system checks and project deadlines.

Mentorship Aptitude: Willingness to provide technical guidance and shared best practices to the eCommerce Operations Analyst to ensure team-wide consistency.

ESSENTIALS - Be Act Engage

At Airgas, excellence is defined through three core behavioral pillars. As a Senior eCommerce Operations Analyst, you are expected to embody these principles in your daily technical and collaborative work:

BE (The Foundation): Demonstrate high personal accountability and professional consistency. Maintain a "heads-down" technical focus while remaining synchronized with the team's needs. Value operational excellence and approach every challenge with a pragmatic, disciplined mindset.

ACT (The Execution): Take the initiative to identify root causes and operational opportunities without constant direction. Execute "Run the Business" (RTB) tasks with precision while simultaneously driving automation agendas. Prioritize "Minimum Viable Products" that solve real-world problems efficiently.

ENGAGE (The Collaboration): Act as a primary liaison with Digital Product Management and Merchandising teams. Foster a culture of user-led iteration by gathering feedback to enhance internal tools. Support the broader team by maintaining a transparent SOP library and mentoring others on technical best practices.

Other Competencies

N/A

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Able to talk, hear, and walk sit: use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel or crouch.

Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to focus objects required.

Benefits

This is evident not only through our competitive compensation but also through a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision plans, short-term and long-term disability, life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), pre-tax commuter transportation benefit, parental leave, vacation, sick time, floating holidays, jury duty and funeral/bereavement leave, and paid holidays for all eligible full-time employees.

Additionally, we offer our eligible employees a 401k plan with company matching funds, tuition reimbursement, discounted college tuition for eligible employees’ dependents, and an Airgas Scholarship Program for dependent children.

We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

Airgas, an Air Liquide company, is a leading U.S. supplier of industrial, medical and specialty gases, as well as hardgoods and related products; one of the largest U.S. suppliers of safety products; and a leading U.S. supplier of ammonia products and process chemicals. Through the passion and diversity of its 18,000 associates, Airgas fosters a culture of safety, customer success, sustainability and innovation. Tempest helps destination organizations be powerful assets for their community. We do this by building websites that locals can be proud of, providing cloud software that strengthens relationships, and marketing programs that support local communities.

Overview

A growing consultancy working across UK and EU is hiring a Data Analyst on a permanent basis. The role is fully remote-first, with occasional client site visits of one to two days per month. Salary is £65,000 - £75,000.

This role exists because the business needs someone who can sit at the intersection of client stakeholders and technical delivery teams, and make both sides work better together. Day to day, that means running workshops, gathering and translating requirements, profiling and modelling data, and making sure what gets built actually holds up against what the client asked for. The business runs modern cloud-native stacks across its projects, so you will move between tools and contexts regularly. What makes this role genuinely interesting is the scope: you own the full analytical pipeline from first conversation with a client through to delivery, and you are expected to think like a strategic partner, not just an executor. If you want variety, real accountability, and the chance to work with high-performing teams on projects that are run well, this is a strong opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

Gather, document, and translate business and project requirements from client stakeholders
Run stakeholder workshops and manage stakeholder mapping across seniority levels, including C-suite
Profile, analyse, and cleanse large and complex datasets
Create conceptual, logical, and physical data models, including lakehouse and warehouse modelling
Produce data mapping specifications for migrations
Build and manage team backlogs using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
Coordinate UAT with business stakeholders and ensure delivery holds up against requirements
Design data storage solutions appropriate to client environments
Build data dashboards and reports in Power BI, Qlik, or Looker, with clear narrative storytelling
Work across cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and modern tooling including Databricks, Snowflake, and dbt

Requirements

Must-haves

Strong SQL skills, hands-on and demonstrable
Python proficiency, particularly pandas
Conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling experience
Requirements gathering and stakeholder management across seniority levels
UAT coordination with business stakeholders
Backlog management using Jira or Azure DevOps
Familiarity with OLTP and OLAP systems
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Comfortable presenting and communicating at C-suite level
Able to operate with low context, build trust quickly, and work independently

Nice-to-haves

Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or dbt
Familiarity with Power BI, Qlik, or Looker
Prior consulting or client-facing delivery experience
Strategic thinking beyond the immediate task, with a track record of influencing decisions

What Success Looks Like

Delivered at least one project end to end, from requirements gathering through to technical delivery
Held accountability for ensuring the technical output meets what the client actually asked for
Built trusted relationships with client stakeholders independently, without heavy internal support
Navigated at least one context switch between clients or tech stacks without losing momentum
Recognised by the team and by clients as someone who adds strategic value, not just analytical output

Team and Culture

Remote-first in practice, with no fixed office requirement and a working pattern built around flexibility
Teams are assembled thoughtfully, with a genuine effort to keep high-performing groups together across projects
The business takes workload and wellbeing seriously, with structured support including mental health provision and flexible arrangements
Agile and scrum are the default ways of working across all projects

Challenges

Consulting contexts mean being dropped into new client environments regularly, often with limited background, and needing to build credibility fast
Stakeholder buy-in is rarely a given: influencing decisions and earning trust are active, ongoing parts of the job
Flipping between different tech stacks and client contexts is the norm, not the exception, so adaptability is genuinely tested
The role demands proactive, independent judgment: waiting to be directed is not a comfortable way to operate here

The role participates in cross-functional teams supporting enhancement releases, bug fixes, new internal tools and the future adoption of data-governance practices.

The incumbent should support Incident & Support Management team when investigating report failures, delivery issues and data discrepancies.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting Platform Administration (WebFOCUS & SQL Server Infrastructure)

Design, develop, enhance and maintain custom and standard reports using WebFOCUS 7.7, Power BI and Power BI Report Builder.
Act as primary administrator for the WebFOCUS 7.7 platform, including user access, provisioning, roles, access removal and security reviews.
Monitor and maintain production, backup, staging and supporting Report Server environments; perform recurring maintenance, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
Manage report scheduling, distribution and ReportCaster operations; maintain server performance and availability.
Support certificate renewals, audits, risk assessments and compliance initiatives.
Support SQL infrastructure and integration – performance analysis, migrations, upgrades, data extraction, SSIS and warehousing where applicable.
Manage reporting-platform capacity, storage, logging, certificates, software upgrades, security updates and operational stability.
Support cybersecurity activities, including TLS exceptions, remediation, audits and secure-transfer modernisation.
Provide client and stakeholder consultation for custom, operational and executive reporting requirements; support migration and modernisation of reporting solutions.

Secure Report Delivery

Lead SFTP delivery requests for ISOS and external client servers using appropriate encryption protocols and security standards.
Lead the design, administration and support of secure client-facing delivery using SFTP, PowerShell, WinSCP, encryption and appropriate ciphers.
Create and maintain automated scheduling, distribution and file-delivery processes for internal and external servers.
Monitor deliveries and resolve failed transfers, access issues and instances where clients do not receive scheduled reports.
Replace unsupported legacy processes with secure automated workflows and improve efficiency through scripting.

Incident & Support Management

Support Incident & Support Management (L2) team with the resolution of reporting incidents: scheduling errors, blank or corrupt output, format/compatibility issues and data discrepancies.
Investigate PNR/data-flow issues across WebFOCUS, Tracker/Quantum and TMC feeds, providing clear root-cause explanations to Client Success Partners and clients.
Act as an escalation point for high-visibility and VIP-impacting report issues, driving them to closure within SLA.

Data Privacy and Data Management

Manage data-purge requests using the in-house tool to upload and purge data in line with client requirements
Manage GDPR requests by querying relevant databases using client identifiers and performing data extraction or deletion in line with the approved request.
Support data-breach mitigation with rapid, controlled purge of mis-queued or incorrectly routed PNRs and profiles.
Write efficient SQL for data retrieval, manipulation, validation and analysis; support data-retention, privacy and information-governance requirements.

Data Quality and Data Governance

Support data profiling, reconciliation and data-quality assessments across key data sources and business applications.
Identify, investigate and document data-quality issues, including business impact, and support root-cause analysis with business and technical teams.
Track data-quality issues and support remediation through closure, including verification of corrective actions.

This position is expected to be filled by promotion/reassignment and is included here to inform you of its vacancy at the University.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career.

Job Summary

The Planning, Analytics, and Institutional Research Office (PAIR) provides leadership and direction to enhance the coordination of institutional data and analysis across the UBC system, providing optimal support to UBC executive, Faculties, staff, government and to external partners. The PAIR office leverages data and analytics to guide university-wide planning and decision-making, to support integrated university planning, to strengthen student learning and experiences, and to promote a deeper understanding of the nature and quality of education at UBC.

Under the direction of the Research & Analytics Leads and the Associate Directors, the Senior Research Analyst performs advanced-level statistical and analytical work to support the strategic priorities of the PAIR team. This will be accomplished by providing statistical analyses, developing predictive models, and creating reporting tools to support strategic planning and inform decision-making. The position will analyze reporting needs, extract data from diverse sources, research and analyze complex datasets, ensure data integrity, develop scorecards and dashboards, analyze performance and capacity metrics, and conduct needs assessments. This role is essential for delivering data-driven insights and advanced analytical support that informs strategic decision-making and institutional planning.

The Senior Research Analyst will lead and support a variety of institutional research functions and high-complexity projects concerning student enrolment, institutional activity, surveys, and data exchanges for the University. The analyst is responsible for planning, designing, conducting, and implementing major complex research projects, interpreting results, and making formal presentations. The analyst also liaises with external stakeholders, including senior representatives from the Ministry and peer institutions’ Institutional Research department leads regarding institutional projects. Assignments will include designing and analyzing surveys, modeling, enrolment forecasting, multi-year planning, and initiating support studies to inform executive-level decisions. The position requires expertise in problem-solving, handling highly sensitive data, coordinating activities across teams, and communicating effectively both orally and in writing. The Senior Research Analyst will actively demonstrate the PAIR team’s commitment to service, quality, integrity, and collaboration, fostering a culture of excellence in data analysis and reporting.

Organizational Status

This position has a functional reporting line to the Research & Analytics Lead, while engaging in collaborative, project-specific reporting and responsibilities as defined by the Research & Analytics Lead(s) and Associate Directors. This position operates within a project-based matrix structure. Under the direction of the Research & Analytics Lead, the Senior Research Analyst will participate in a variety of projects as part of a team of analysts and work independently.

This position interacts with other office staff, with staff from other departments, faculty, senior academic officers including Vice-presidents, Deans, Directors, Department Heads, Senate Committees, and representatives of other universities, units within the provincial government reporting teams, representatives of the Research University Council of BC, U15 Data Exchange, and other higher education and university-related organizations.

Work Performed

Provide expert advice and deliver accurate, meaningful information for use by senior administrative and academic officers and committees to support policy formulation, strategic decision-making, and issue resolution.
Identify key research and evaluation needs and lead the design, development, and implementation of analytic reports and statistical information on various subjects, including enrolment forecasting, benchmarking, performance indicators, tuition modeling, department profiles, and inter-university comparisons.
Lead the implementation of research projects, including designing project elements, selecting research methodology, ethical considerations, interpreting results, and preparing and delivering formal presentations.
Consult with internal clients to identify information requirements, recommend appropriate metrics/key performance indicators, and develop solutions for evaluating programs and measuring performance of strategic plans.
Liaise with external stakeholders, including Ministry representatives and peer institutions, regarding institutional projects and data-sharing initiatives.
Extract and synthesize sensitive data from multiple databases, develop computer programs for statistical reporting, and contribute to database revisions or designs.
Provides second tier support, troubleshoots issues and coordinates resolutions deployment with other technical staff, including report enhancements and data model extensions.
Initiate projects, establish timelines, validate results, and communicate findings to stakeholders.
Ensure quality assurance across all data analysis processes, including sampling methods, data collection, and data processing, and provide recommendations to improve data quality.
Perform advanced statistical analysis using programming languages and communicate results through statistical summaries, visualizations, tables, and written descriptions.
Provide mentoring/peer coaching for team members based on knowledge and expertise, fostering professional growth and ensuring consistency in data analysis methodologies.
Manage and maintain comprehensive, accurate analysis and reporting to support university-wide financial planning and other critical decisions.
Prepare reports and analyses for submission to government agencies and other external bodies.
Provides reports and analyses for CIRO for strategic projects as needed.
Performs other related duties as required.

Consequence of Error/Judgement

The Senior Research Analyst, given initial parameters, is expected to independently plan and execute projects, obtain data, and conduct analyses with minimal supervision. Outputs are reviewed by Research & Analytics Leads and/or Associate Directors and inform key policy, planning, and resource allocation decisions. Errors in design, interpretation, or analysis could result in poor administrative decisions, resource misallocation, and reputational harm to the University and its leadership. The incumbent’s work must reflect high standards of accuracy, judgment, and confidentiality.

Supervision Received

This position works with significant autonomy, under the direction of the Research & Analytics Lead(s) and general guidance of the Associate Directors. The incumbent is expected to show considerable initiative in managing their assigned projects and resolving complex issues.

Supervision Given

The Senior Research Analyst leads project teams, provides direction to Research Analysts, Data & Reporting Analysts, and student employees, and ensures the quality and timeliness of project outputs. The incumbent also mentors less experienced staff and contributes to team capacity-building.

Minimum Qualifications

Post-graduate degree in a relevant discipline. Minimum of six years of related experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own
Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree with a focus on social science research or quantitative analysis preferred. Minimum of five years’ experience in research, analysis, and measurement, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage large datasets and perform complex statistical analyses. Proficiency in advanced statistical software (e.g., R, SPSS, SAS, STATA) and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau). Knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and survey deployment tools (e.g., Qualtrics) is an asset. Experience with institutional research, including survey design, enrolment forecasting, and program evaluation. Proven leadership skills in project management, survey research, and stakeholder collaboration. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present complex ideas and statistics in accessible ways. Commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in all aspects of research and analysis. Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment and within cross-functional projects.
